reason: Watch: AI credit stress (CoreWeave distressed, Oracle CDS near record) and memory equities down sharply; macro flags: high-yield spread widening.

indicators.name: S&P 500 vs 10-month average
indicators.value_text: Close 7,659 vs provisional 10-month average 7,312 (provisional until month-end); last month-end avg 7,231
indicators.trigger_text: Month-end close below 10-month SMA (tripped); latest close below it intra-month (watch)

indicators.name: Yield curve (10y minus 3m)
indicators.trigger_text: T10Y3M below 0 for 5+ consecutive daily readings (tripped); 0 to +0.25 (watch)

indicators.name: Baa corporate spread (BAA10Y)
indicators.trigger_text: At or above 2.13 or up 50 bp from 12-month low (tripped); up 30 bp (watch)

indicators.name: High-yield spread (HY OAS)
indicators.trigger_text: At or above 5.0 or up 100 bp in 3 months (tripped); up 50 bp (watch)

indicators.name: Initial jobless claims (4-wk avg)
indicators.trigger_text: 20% or more above 52-week low (tripped); 15% or more (watch)

indicators.name: Fed policy path
indicators.value_text: Target range 3.75-4.00%; effective 3.88%; last move a hike on 2026-09-17

indicators.name: AI credit: Oracle rating and CDS, CoreWeave bonds
indicators.value_text: Oracle BBB- (S&P); Oracle 5y CDS ~288 bp (Oct 15); CoreWeave 9.75% 2031 notes ~78-82, yield ~15-16%
indicators.trigger_text: Tripped: Oracle at junk, or CDS 300 bp+ sustained, or a CoreWeave failed issue, or a second neocloud bond under 80. Watch: CDS 250 bp+ or CoreWeave bond under 80.

indicators.name: Hyperscaler capex guidance
indicators.value_text: Big-four 2026 guidance about $700-730B, still rising; next prints late Oct 2026
indicators.trigger_text: Tripped: two or more big-four capex cuts in a quarter, or next-year growth guidance under 20%.

indicators.name: AI lab funding and IPO window
indicators.value_text: OpenAI $852B (Mar 2026 round); Anthropic reportedly ~$965B, confidential S-1 filed June 2026, IPO possibly as early as Oct 2026
indicators.trigger_text: Tripped: a down round, a pulled or broken IPO, or a secondary discount of 20% or more.

indicators.name: DRAM contract prices and memory equities
indicators.value_text: Q3 2026 DRAM contract +13-18% QoQ, slowing from ~+60% in Q2 (TrendForce); memory equities down 40-56% from June highs
indicators.trigger_text: Tripped: contract prices down quarter on quarter, or spot down 10% in 3 months. Watch: memory equities down 30%+ from peak (they lead prices by 3 to 9 months).

indicators.name: GPU rental prices (H100)
indicators.value_text: SemiAnalysis H100 1-yr contract index $2.35/hr (Mar 2026), up from $1.70 (Oct 2025); Uvik on-demand median $4.20 (Oct 7)
indicators.trigger_text: Tripped: H100 1-year index under $1.70/hr, or down 15% in 3 months.

indicators.name: Data center lease cancellations
indicators.value_text: No 2026 cancellations reported; Feb 2025 Microsoft episode (~couple hundred MW) was a false alarm
indicators.trigger_text: Tripped: two or more hyperscalers cancelling 500 MW or more of leases.

indicators.name: S&P 500 earnings revisions
indicators.value_text: FactSet Oct 9: Q3 2026 S&P growth est. 29.6%, raised during quarter; negative guidance 44 vs positive 72
indicators.trigger_text: Tripped: three straight months of net negative revisions, or forward EPS 3% below peak.

indicators.name: TSMC monthly revenue (manual fallback)
indicators.trigger_text: Tripped: 3-month average YoY growth under 20%, or two straight monthly drops of 5%+.
